name: mk-josias/laravel-distributable-modules
description: Laravel modules built as independently deployable microservices: each owns its data, and they talk through events and RPC. Run them as one app, or split them apart whenever you want.

suggest.laravel/octane: High-throughput application server; the kernel also runs under plain FPM
suggest.mk-josias/laravel-microservices-http-rpc: Calls to a module running in another process, over signed HTTP
